title: Armor Watch
description: Armor Watch adds a small HUD display on the right side of the screen that shows the armor you currently have equipped and each piece’s remaining durability, so you can keep track of wear without opening your inventory.
body: Armor Watch adds a small HUD display on the right side of the screen that shows the armor you currently have equipped and each piece’s remaining durability, so you can keep track of wear without opening your inventory. It also includes Mod Menu settings to adjust the display’s vertical position and overall size.
